title: Bound for a truncated mapped sum
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list and let $f$ assign an integer to each element of its type. Suppose there is an integer $B$ such that $|f(x)|\le B$ for every $x$ occurring in $l$. For every natural number $k$, the absolute value of the sum of the first $k$ values of $f$ on $l$ is at most $\operatorname{length}(l)B$.
